name: Patient Anvil
summary: Repair and combine at the anvil at any cost you can pay: the level wall is gone, while every price stays exactly as in vanilla.
logoPrompt: A heavy dark iron anvil with a glowing enchanted diamond pickaxe resting on top, in blocky voxel style, no text

cover.tagline: No more Too Expensive at the anvil.

description: **Patient Anvil takes down the anvil's "Too Expensive!" wall, so a well-loved pickaxe can be repaired and enchanted again for as long as you have the levels.**
- Repairs and enchantment combinations that cost 40 levels or more are no longer refused.
- Every cost stays the vanilla cost: nothing gets cheaper, it only becomes possible.
- You still pay the full cost; without enough levels the result cannot be taken.
- Creative mode, the rename discount and the rest of the anvil work as before.
Put the jar into the `mods` folder next to Fabric API: on the server, and on your own game if you like. Then use the anvil as usual.
- Made for Fabric on Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 and needs Fabric API. Works in singleplayer and on servers.
- On a server only the server needs it. Players without the mod still read "Too Expensive!" in red, but the result appears and can be taken; with the mod they see the real cost.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
